goal: DynamoDB alarms + DAX. (1) ALARMS/MONITOR: dynamodb_core publishes the real AWS/DynamoDB metrics through cloudwatch_core.ingest_internal_metric (ConsumedRead/WriteCapacityUnits, ProvisionedRead/WriteCapacityUnits, ThrottledRequests, Read/WriteThrottleEvents, UserErrors, SystemErrors, SuccessfulRequestLatency, ReturnedItemCount; ItemCount/TableSizeBytes) on every operation, on Nano and offline (same CloudWatch store the CloudWatch console reads). Compute consumed capacity the AWS way (4 KB read units, eventually consistent = half, 1 KB write units, transactions x2) and return ConsumedCapacity when ReturnConsumedCapacity is set. ENFORCE provisioned throughput with a per-table/GSI token bucket (burst = 300 s of capacity) → real ProvisionedThroughputExceededException; on-demand never throttles. Table Monitor tab = real GetMetricData charts; Alarms tab lists alarms on the table and 'Create alarm' pre-fills TableName dims; actions go to simulator SNS. Expose the cache data plane through the console/test hooks; the DAX binary wire protocol comes later (wave 6 tunnel TCP relay) — say so honestly in the capability (Nano/offline 'limited' for SDK data-plane access until then). Wire the existing DAX console pages (clusters, subnet groups, parameter groups, events) to the live core; add capability entries aws.dynamodb.dax.* (there are none today), tests in tests/conformance, smoke round-trips.
